exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: The check fails when findings reach “Fail CI on” (now: {failOn}). To block merging, also mark the DevDigest check as required in branch protection or a ruleset. “Fail CI on” is changed on the agent’s CI tab.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.noRepos: Connect a repository to this workspace first.
exportWizard.checkingRepo: Checking who runs in this repository…
exportWizard.occupied: {repo} already runs the agent “{agent}” in CI. One agent per repository for now.
exportWizard.occupiedCheckFailed: Could not check this repository’s CI installations.
exportWizard.workflowTooLarge: The workflow is {bytes} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes (64 KB).
exportWizard.triggersHint: pull_request events that run the review.
exportWizard.secretsHint: Add these to your repo’s Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.githubReviewNote: Needs the repository setting that lets GitHub Actions create pull request reviews.
exportWizard.installPrTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.updatePrBody: DevDigest commits the {count} generated files to the existing devdigest/ci PR in {repo}.
exportWizard.zipBody: Download the {count} files and add them to {repo} yourself.
exportWizard.needHelp: Need help? Using secrets in GitHub Actions
exportWizard.waitingForFiles: Generating the files for these settings…

errorHint.ci_repo_has_agent: Another agent already runs in CI on this repository.
errorHint.ci_manifest_conflict: The repository already has an agent manifest DevDigest does not own. Remove it, then try again.
errorHint.ci_file_conflict: The repository already has files DevDigest did not write. Remove or rename them, then try again.
errorHint.ci_concurrent_change: devdigest/ci changed on GitHub meanwhile. Nothing was written — try again.
errorHint.ci_pr_base_mismatch: An open DevDigest PR targets another base branch. Close it, then try again.
errorHint.ci_runner_bundle_missing: The CI runner is not built on the server (cd agent-runner && pnpm build).
errorHint.network_error: The DevDigest engine is not reachable. Check that the API is running, then try again.
errorHint.external_service_error: GitHub refused the request. Check the token and its access to the repository.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
